The '''Third Mission to Rodia''' was a mission carried out by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]]. As a part of the campaign to destroy a new Separatist [[Radar-cloaking superweapon|superweapon]], the Republic sent Denal to Rodia with the task of infiltrating a local [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] base that supplied the main enemy headquarters with weapons, and to blow it up by planting several charges. Denal successfully completed the task.
